native_mechanisms: A fixed row of beast-pawns against a second row that the horse's-head piece may slip forward at exactly one house, trying the alignment unslipped and slipped at every possible position.
March both rows house by house marking agreement (lotus petal) vs disagreement (red knot) one position per flute note — a positionwise mismatch tally.
Weigh each trial's fist of knots and keep only the lightest count, flinging all other trials' counts away — take the minimum over trials as the answer.
core_technique: Banded anti-diagonal SIMD (AVX2) Needleman-Wunsch wavefront over int16/int32 lanes, with the band half-width W derived from a single-shift Hamming-based score lower bound (plus an exact two-row DP fallback for small n or allocation failure).
